summary: Verified the Participant+Family signup bug fix (Caren-style second participant now pre-created). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASS covering signup, v2/participants stub semantics (is_primary=false), primary-slot preservation, default derivation, no-downgrade guarantee, and legacy /api/participants create becoming primary when only a non-primary stub exists. Frontend: verified /signup?plan=family renders the second-participant block with participant-specific copy, field sets match between participant and caregiver roles (first_name required + relationship optional), and end-to-end submit fires POST /v2/participants (first_name=Caren, is_primary=false) BEFORE the Stripe Checkout redirect. Auto-heal on /app/participants verified by code review (logic matches spec; idempotent by first_name, gated on exactly 1 active participant, intent cleared on success).
critical_code_review_comments: batch2_routes.py POST /participants is dead code — the participant_profile router (registered first at line 6403 of server.py) shadows POST /api/participants with a stricter Tier1 schema (first_name/last_name/dob/classification_level/pension_status/provider_name/statement_delivery/authorisation_confirmed). The fix in batch2_routes.py (has_primary count-based derivation) is never reached in production; the equivalent correct logic lives in participant_profile.py line 380-415 (is_primary=(existing_primary is None)). The batch2 fix isn't harmful, just redundant — consider removing or documenting the shadowing.

The signup flow's fallback (localStorage intent) plus the auto-heal on Participants page provide good safety net for legacy accounts, but note the auto-heal only triggers with EXACTLY 1 active participant. If the user manually created 2 participants via UI before ever visiting /app/participants, the intent will linger — cleanup on account load might be safer (clear intent whenever list already contains a participant with matching first_name).

rca of the issue: Original bug: John's Caren was stored only in localStorage as an 'intent' from Signup.jsx and required John to click 'Set up X now' from the All Done page. He never did, so Caren was never persisted. Fix confirmed: Signup.jsx now POSTs /v2/participants with is_primary=false immediately after successful signup and BEFORE the Stripe redirect. Participants.jsx has a client-side auto-heal for existing legacy accounts. Primary-derivation in both /participants (participant_profile router) and /v2/participants uses 'no primary exists' rather than 'zero participants exist', so the non-primary stub never displaces the true primary.
